name: Geometric Packing Isomorphism
description: Replaced all references to "minimal completion time" and "total assigned processing volume" (which readily map to `p1+p2` and `sum(p)`) with a 1D geometric packing equivalent. The certificates are now defined by the impossibility of placing continuous blocks into a window of size T without them overlapping by a positive duration. This rigorously specifies the exact same inequalities (sum > T) but forces the model to deduce the arithmetic reduction from spatial constraints, defeating models that rely on surface pattern matching of scheduling terminology.
